column1: # RELATION GRAPH VERDICTS (RELATIONS.0.md §3.3, replacing the G4
# phase 5 magic-key pass). Acyclicity and inverse consistency over the
# edge set, DECLARED by the graph atoms -- `acyclic()` and
# `inverse(name)` conjoined at the field whose key is the predicate --
# and decided at GENERATION, never by unification.
# Why not in the lattice. Both properties are GLOBAL and NON-MONOTONE:
# an acyclic graph becomes cyclic when one more edge unifies in, and an
# inverse that is present becomes absent when the far side is narrowed.
# The lattice guarantee is that more information never falsifies what
# has been observed, so a constraint that could be true and then false
# is not a constraint the lattice may hold. The atoms therefore only
# REGISTER during unification, and the verdict lands where no more
# information can arrive: generation refuses with a located
# relation_cycle / relation_inverse_missing, and the `relations` verb
# reports the same findings from the same declarations.
# The old declaration channel -- a `relations:` key at the document
# root -- is GONE, discharging ADR-010's grandfather clause; the row
# `relations-key-is-user-space` pins the discharge. The `target:` half
# of the old declaration is `relate(t)`'s flow at the site, pinned at the
# end of this file. Mode `relation`: `expect` is the whole verb report
# as JSON.
# Every expectation was obtained by the parity probe (AGENTS.md).
no-relations-declared
relation-declared-nothing-asked
# Asked for by `acyclic()` and by nothing else: a cycle in a relation
# nobody declared acyclic is DATA, and the engine has no opinion about
# it. A cycle is reported ONCE, with the entities it runs through
# closing back on the first, and only for the relation that asked. An
# edge into a node INSIDE an entity is an edge to that entity: a
# relation holds between entities, and the path inside one says which
# part of it the link reaches.
acyclic-holds
acyclic-two-cycle
acyclic-three-cycle

# is ordinary user data -- the magic key is retired (ADR-010's
# grandfather clause discharged).
edge-at-the-top-starts-at-the-root
broken-document-is-not-blamed-on-relations
# ... AND NEITHER IS ONE THAT CANNOT BE GENERATED. Unification can
# succeed over a tree that still holds an unsettled disjunction, which
# `disjunct_no_gen` refuses at generation, and the graph walk cannot
# read inside one: the links in its alternatives are invisible, so a
# mirror the document writes can be missing from the edge set. The
# verdict is therefore asked of generation first, and what generation
# says is the answer -- the same order the engine itself refuses in.
ungenerable-document-is-not-blamed-on-relations
# A MIRROR WRITTEN BY A SECOND STATEMENT OF THE SAME ENTITY. The
# field's constraint is driven at the entity when the statements
# merge, and a conjunct member that took the entity's own path stamped
# a relate()-minted link with the ENTITY's key as its predicate: the
# mirror was then looked for under a relation nobody declared, and a
# written one was reported missing.
inverse-mirror-written-by-a-second-statement
